[[File:Hal AG106.png|thumb|250px|Hal]] '''Hal''' (Japanese: '''ヘイハチロー''' ''Heihachirō'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[AG106|Beg, Burrow and Steal]]''. [[File:Young Hal.png|thumb|left|200px|As a child]] Hal is a researcher from the [[Izabe Island]] Academy. He dedicated his time to studying {{p|Trapinch}} after stumbling upon [[Trapinch underground labyrinth|a hidden Pokémon paradise]] when he was younger. He claimed that, in the hidden paradise, he witnessed hundreds of {{p|Trapinch}} [[Evolution|evolve]] into {{p|Vibrava}}. His childhood friend [[Elisa]] disagreed with him, saying such a paradise could not possibly exist. To prove his point, Hal attached a tracking device to a Trapinch and followed it around. Somehow, he, Elisa, along with {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}}, ended up underground. After finding their way through a series of tunnels, they stumbled across the very same paradise that Hal was talking about. They also witnessed hundreds of Trapinch evolving into Vibrava. {{TRT}} appeared and tried to steal the newly evolved Pokémon, but {{an|Brock}}, using his {{TP|Brock|Ludicolo}}, along with {{AP|Pikachu}}, freed the Pokémon and sent Team Rocket blasting off. Afterwards, Elisa apologized to Hal for doubting him, and the Vibrava flew everybody out of the paradise. ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{ground color}}|bordercolor={{water color light}} |ja=高戸靖広 ''[[Yasuhiro Takato]]'' |en=[[Jamie McGonnigal]] |fi=Peter Pihlström |fr_eu=Grégory Praet |pt_br=Rodrigo Andreatto |es_eu=Rafa Romero
